statuses.not_yet_researched: Nobody has established this yet. Never replace it with a guess.
statuses.unknown: Investigated, and the evidence does not settle it.
statuses.not_applicable: The question does not apply, for a stated reason.

basis.actor_statement: The people involved said so in the source.
basis.historian_judgement: A cited secondary source argues it.
basis.reviewer_inference: The coder inferred it from the evidence. This is interpretation and must be labelled as such.

advance_type.question: What was actually new? An entry can have several values.

values.observation: A phenomenon or object seen or detected for the first time.
values.measurement: A quantity established, or established more precisely.
values.experimental_method: A new way of finding things out.
values.explanation: A new account of why something happens.
values.unification: Separate bodies of knowledge shown to be one.
values.mathematical_method: A new way of calculating, proving or representing.
values.correction: An accepted idea shown to be wrong or replaced.
values.dataset: A compiled resource others can draw on.
values.standard_or_scale: A unit, scale, classification or interface others adopt.
values.field_or_clinical_trial: A deliberate test in real conditions, on patients or at sea for example.
values.operating_principle: A device that works in a fundamentally new way.
values.device_or_configuration: A new artefact or arrangement using known principles.
values.performance_improvement: The same thing made measurably better.
values.material: A new or newly controllable substance.
values.manufacturing_process: A new way of making something.
values.cost_or_scale: The same thing made cheap or plentiful enough to change who uses it.
values.system_integration: Existing parts combined into a working whole.
values.infrastructure: A shared facility or network that others build on.
values.craft_practice: Skill held in people and practice more than in documents.
values.new_application: An existing thing put to a different use.
values.codification_or_teaching: Knowledge written down or taught so it can spread.
values.reconstruction: Something earlier rebuilt or revived deliberately.

change_scale.question: How far did it disturb what came before? Choose one.

values.incremental: Technology: better within the same design.
values.modular: Technology: one component changes, and the overall design stays.
values.architectural: Technology: known components rearranged in a new way.
values.radical: Technology: new principle and new arrangement.
values.revises: Science: changes part of accepted understanding.
values.opens_field: Science: makes a new line of enquiry possible.

prompted_by.question: What set people working on this? This is the prompt, not the enabler. An entry can have several values.

values.new_capability: A new instrument, method or material made people go and look.
values.prior_theory: A theory made a prediction or pointed somewhere.
values.data_or_measurements: Existing results demanded better accuracy or explanation.
values.anomaly_or_failure: Something did not fit, or something broke.
values.practical_need: An engineering, medical, navigational or everyday problem.
values.state_or_military: A government, war or defence requirement.
values.transfer_from_other_field: An idea carried across from another discipline.
values.transmission_from_other_place: News or an example arriving from elsewhere.
values.systematic_search: A deliberate, broad programme of trying things.
values.accident: An unplanned result that someone recognised.
values.curiosity: Understanding for its own sake, with no stated use.

limit_removed.question: Which bottleneck did it relieve? An entry can have several values. Second wave.

values.scale: Doing more of it, or a larger one.
values.access: Letting more people or places do it.
values.conceptual: A way of thinking was the obstacle.

reception.question: How was it received? Choose one. Third wave.

values.immediate: Taken up quickly by its community.
values.gradual: Spread slowly without a real dispute.
values.delayed: Largely ignored, then taken up much later.
values.lost_and_recovered: Knowledge or practice lost, then recovered.

end_reason.question: If it ended or declined, why? An entry can have several values. Third wave, and only with documented lifecycle evidence.

values.better_substitute: Something else did the job better.
values.input_or_skill_lost: A material, supplier or skill disappeared.
values.regulation_or_safety: It was restricted or judged unsafe.
values.maker_failure: The company or institution behind it ended.

inclusion_reason.question: Why is this entry in the graph at all? Required for any statistics. Choose one.

values.canonical_landmark: Included because it is famous or widely cited.
values.case_study_chain: Included to fill out a particular story.
values.regional_coverage: Included to correct a geographic or cultural imbalance.
values.counterexample: Included as a dead end, failure or exception.
values.exhaustive_frame: Included because a defined list requires it, with no selection by the researcher.

contribution.question: What actually passed from one to the other? A link can have several values.

values.supplied_instrument: It was the tool used to observe or measure.
values.supplied_component: It became a part of the later thing.
values.supplied_platform: It was the base on which the later work took place.
values.supplied_theory_or_design_rule: It told people what to do or expect.
values.supplied_data: Its numbers or results were used.
values.posed_problem: It raised the question being answered.
values.challenged_or_refuted: The later work argued against it.
values.improved_on: The later thing is a better version in the same line.
values.replaced: The later thing displaced it in practice.
values.implemented: An idea or design was turned into a working thing.
values.applied_to_new_use: It was carried into a different purpose.
values.taught_or_transmitted: Knowledge of it was passed on.
values.stimulated: News or example prompted the work without supplying its content.

dependence.question: How much did the later thing rely on this? Structured form of the existing free-text necessity field. Choose one.

values.required_in_this_case: This specific instance could not have happened without it. Not a claim about all possible routes.
values.materially_enabled: It made a real practical difference.
values.contributed: It was one input among several.
values.stimulus_only: It prompted the work, and no content passed.

carrier.question: How did the knowledge or thing get across? A link can have several values. Second wave.

values.migration: A person with the knowledge moved.
values.artifact_or_copying: Someone had the object and copied or studied it.

new_records.lineage: A named family of related entries, such as refracting-telescope. An entry can belong to several.
new_records.open_dependencies: Known prerequisites that have no entry yet. Each is a research lead, not a claim, until sourced.
new_records.capability: A measured or claimed performance value for an entry: quantity, value or range, unit, conditions, date, status (measured, claimed or derived), and evidence.
new_records.actor: A person or organisation with a role on an entry and a type: individual, workshop, guild, court, religious body, university, state laboratory, military, firm, community.
new_records.funder: Who paid: patron, state, military, church, firm, self, community, unknown.
new_records.place: A normalised location for an event: settlement, historical polity, modern country, world region.
new_records.parallel_group: Entries that independently reached the same result, with evidence that they were independent.

compute_do_not_label: Number of downstream entries, reach and centrality
Direction of flow between science and technology
Whether a link crosses fields or regions
